about.heroSubtitle: A leading institution shaping the future of computing and data science education.
about.deanMessage: In an era of rapid technological progress, data science has become a central driver of innovation across every sector. Alexandria University established the Faculty of Computers and Data Science to lead this transformation. Our programs in Business Analytics, Intelligent Systems, Media Analytics, Healthcare Informatics, and Cybersecurity combine practical skills with forward-looking thinking. Whether your passion is AI, analytics, media, healthcare, or security, FCDS opens a path for you to help build tomorrow.
about.visionText: To be a leading academic destination in computer and data sciences, recognized regionally and internationally for excellence in education, research, and innovation.
about.missionText: To deliver high-quality, industry-relevant education that combines applied skills with critical thinking, preparing graduates who can lead digital transformation across diverse fields.
